description: Size of an LZ4 frame header from its magic number and FLG byte: 8 for skippable frames, an error code for an unknown magic
notes: LZ4 1.10.0, LZ4F_headerSize (lib/lz4frame.c). The little-endian magic word (LZ4F_readLE32(src)) and the FLG byte (src[4]) are parameters; the NULL pointer and srcSize checks are dropped. Constants: LZ4F_MAGIC_SKIPPABLE_START = 0x184D2A50, LZ4F_MAGICNUMBER = 0x184D2204, minFHSize = 7, and RETURN_ERROR(frameType_unknown) returns (size_t)-13. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: two compare-and-branch steps and a phi: 15 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
